text:
ana: Quick heads-up — kicking off a small 'lite' rollout for the token-cost attribution pipeline. Will be 1% canary for events with the new lightweight schema. Need owners to confirm readiness for ingestion + dashboards.

mike: @ana I can take the PR review (https://git.internal/r/redwood/instr/pulls/7841). Will check tests and schema validation today. :eyes:

jess: Can you paste the schema diff here? want to make sure we aren't regressing existing fields consumers rely on.

ana: putting it below — it's intentionally minimal, just enough to do cost attribution without full token replica fields: 
```yaml
event: token_usage_lite_v1
fields:
  event_id: string
  customer_id: string
  timestamp_ms: int
  token_count: int
  cost_usd_est: float
  latency_ms: int
  sampling_rate: float  # metadata for ingestion
```

priya: Thanks — a couple notes: 1) our billing join expects 'customer_id' to be nullable=false (ok), 2) will the 'cost_usd_est' be precomputed by the agent or by the ingest lambda?

ana: cost_usd_est computed at emit time by SDKs when available; for servers we add a simple estimator in the ingestion path so fallback exists.

mike: quick checklist from my side: 
- ran schema validator -> passes
- tests: missing a small unit test around sampling metadata (I'll add)
- PR: needs a changelog entry and a data-consumers ping thread

jess: On dashboards — we need the latency breakdown per model family to catch regressions. Can someone add a derived metric: p50/p95 over the 'latency_ms' for this event and tag by model_id?

priya: I can add the metric to the attribution dashboard, but need the model_id tag to be present. Are we including model_id in this lite event?

ana: Not in the initial lite schema to keep size down. Proposal: include model_family (small enum) instead of full model_id. That should be enough for rollouts.

mike: ok if we add model_family, I'll update the ingest mapping. New field: model_family: string (nullable). Will update PR.

telemetry-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployed to us-west-2 (sample_rate=0.01). Hash: dc3a9f.

jess: :thumbsup: good to know. @mike once you add the test and model_family field, can you post a quick smoke query we can run after canary?

mike: will do. Example smoke queries: 
```sql
-- count new events in last 10m
SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE event='token_usage_lite_v1' AND ingestion_time > now() - interval '10 minutes';

-- check sampling metadata
SELECT sampling_rate, count(*) FROM events WHERE event='token_usage_lite_v1' GROUP BY sampling_rate;
```

priya: Also, FYI for billing — we need a mapping table from model_family -> pricing_tier. I'll add a PR to the billing repo and tag @billing on Monday.

ana: blockers?

mike: just the missing unit test and changelog. expect to finish in ~3h.

jess: I'll watch the canary dashboards this afternoon and surface any metric drift. If we see token counts drop unexpectedly, we'll pause the rollout.

ana: thanks all. I'll post a follow-up in #product when we flip to 10% if canary looks healthy. If anyone wants to join a quick sync at 3pm PT, ping here.

priya: pinged billing. Also scheduling a short QA smoke run at 2:30pm PT to validate joins.

mike: PR updated: added test, changelog, and model_family mapping. linking: https://git.internal/r/redwood/instr/pulls/7841/files.

telemetry-bot: canary-metrics: token_usage_lite_v1: 1,243 events in last 15m across us-west-2.

jess: Saw the numbers — looks healthy. Leaving :eyes: on p95 latency.

ana: great work team — will report status after the 2:30 QA run.
